title: 第5章 将军乞求神明赐水成功了第6章 养十万古人
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 叶苜苜醒来已经是半夜，她躺在父母房间的沙发上，抱枕上有一摊湿。
她太想念他们，在睡梦中又哭了。
凌晨两点半，下楼客厅灯光依旧亮着。
只是花瓶下多了好几张纸黄纸。
啊！
花瓶又往家里洒垃圾！
她火气噌蹭冒，走到一楼客厅，把黄色沾满灰尘的纸捡起。
字体是繁体字，竖着书写。
像是用石锅灰写的，墨迹断断续续不连贯。
以前不过是几个字，现在洋洋洒洒一大篇，笔迹锋利，字迹狂草。
一共是四张纸，她不知道写什么。
用手机拍下软件翻译，才看清楚写的祷祭词：
大启初元三年，战家军镇守边关要塞，遇蛮族三十万把镇关围成死城。
二十万将士，战死至两万人。
镇关大旱，水草枯竭。
百姓颗粒无收，草皮树木吃光。
城中百姓二十万人，饿死无数，只剩八万人苟延残喘。
写祷词的人，称她为神明。
请求她赐水和食，一品宁关候愿以命相抵。
全城百姓会为她建筑庙宇，世代香火供奉。
剩下的两张纸，写了两个故事。
拿着亲生儿子去交换的残暴父亲。
还有一个故事，奶奶以血喂养孙女，攒了几天草根送给宁关候，只求孙女不沦为他人口粮。
惨！
惨目忍睹！
所以，这些垃圾……信件是来自大启初元三年？
可国内史书上并没有这个朝代。
她家祖传花瓶捡到的是古代垃圾！
为了验证消息准确性，叶苜苜跑到楼上爸爸书房里。
拿两叠4A纸，墨水两瓶，钢笔两支，毛笔四支……抱到下楼。
她先用手机打出回信，再翻成繁体字。
钢笔照着繁体字书写。
爸爸要求她从小练字帖，她练了十年瘦金体，字不算难看。
“你好，我不是神明，我叫叶苜苜，是一个普通女生。”
“我家出现带血绷带，带血刀尖都是你的？请不要再往我家里丢垃圾，很难清理。”
content_en:
It was already midnight when Ye Clover woke up. She was lying on the sofa in her parents' room, and there was a pool of wetness on the pillow.
She missed them so much that she cried again in her sleep.
At half past two in the morning, the lights in the living room downstairs were still on.
There are just a few extra pieces of yellow paper under the vase.
ah!
The vase sprinkles garbage into the house again!
Angry, she walked to the living room on the first floor and picked up the yellow dusty paper.
The font is traditional Chinese, written vertically.
It looked like it was written in stone pot ashes, and the ink marks were intermittent and inconsistent.
It used to be just a few words, but now it's a long article, with sharp handwriting and wild cursive handwriting.
There were four pieces of paper in total, and she didn't know what to write.
I used my mobile phone to take a picture of the software translation, and then I could clearly see the written prayer:
In the third year of the First Yuan Dynasty of the Great Qi Dynasty, the Zhan family army guarded the border fortress and encountered 300,000 barbarians who surrounded the town and turned it into a dead city.
Of the 200,000 soldiers killed in the battle, 20,000 were killed.
There was a severe drought in Zhenguan and the water and grass dried up.
The people had nothing to gain, and the turf and trees were all eaten up.
There were 200,000 people in the city, many of them starved to death, and only 80,000 people were left alive.
Those who write prayers call her a god.
Ask her for water and food, Yipin Ningguanhou is willing to give her life to compensate.
People all over the city will build temples for her and offer incense to her for generations.
On the remaining two pieces of paper, two stories were written.
A cruel father who offered his biological son in exchange.
There is also a story about a grandma who fed her granddaughter with blood and saved grass roots for several days to give to Ningguan Hou, hoping that her granddaughter would not become someone else's ration.
miserable!
Horrible!
So, these junk... letters are from the third year of the First Yuan Dynasty of Daqi?
But there is no such dynasty in domestic history books.
The ancestral vase found in her family was ancient garbage!
In order to verify the accuracy of the news, Ye Clover ran upstairs to his father's study.
Get two stacks of 4A paper, two bottles of ink, two pens, four brushes... and carry them downstairs.
She first typed the reply on her mobile phone and then translated it into traditional Chinese characters.
The pen writes in traditional Chinese characters.
Her father asked her to practice calligraphy since she was a child. She has practiced Slim Gold Body for ten years, and her handwriting is not ugly.
"Hello, I'm not a god. My name is Ye Clover, and I'm an ordinary girl."
"There are bloody bandages in my house. Are the bloody knife tips yours? Please stop throwing garbage into my house. It's difficult to clean."
